observations.expected: PA view shows increased radial inclination and a triangular carpus with proximal lunate subsidence.
observations.observed: On the PA view, the distal radius shows increased radial inclination with a shortened ulnar-side radius. The carpal row appears triangular in configuration with the lunate subsiding proximally between radius and ulna, consistent with Madelung deformity.

observations.expected: Lateral view shows increased volar tilt with dorsal prominence of the distal ulna.
observations.observed: On the lateral view, the distal radius demonstrates increased volar tilt and the distal ulna is dorsally prominent relative to the radius, consistent with the expected lateral findings of Madelung deformity.

observations.expected: Radius and ulna are separate coherent bones, with no duplicated carpal bones.
observations.observed: Both the radius and ulna are individually traceable as separate, coherent bones on both views. The carpal bones appear as distinct, individual ossicles without duplication. No floating or extra bones are identified. Five metacarpals and appropriate digit count are visible.
